Chapter 1076 17 Great Saint's Tactics (Please Subscribe)

This grasp tore open chaos, tore open space and time, and reached toward the Nine Profound Venerable. "What is this?" Nine Profound Venerable felt an inexplicable sense of fear.

Even when faced with the destruction and collapse of tens of millions of light years a moment ago, Nine Profound Venerable had not experienced such soul-deep terror.

It would tear him apart.

It would shred him to pieces.

These thoughts surged in Nine Profound Venerable's mind.

Soon after, confusion arose.

Who?

Who was attacking him?

At the very moment this grasp targeted Nine Profound Venerable, a karmic connection was forged between him and its origin.

Mysteriously, Nine Profound Venerable glimpsed a scene—

From far across countless spacetime layers.

A young man was slowly withdrawing his right hand, with five streams of ultimate "Tearing Heaven" power lingering in the void.

Beside the young man stood Cang Yulong; the Stone People was staring blankly at the former.

Nine Profound Venerable paid no attention to Cang Yulong. Through the brief karmic bond, his gaze locked onto the young man who had unleashed the "Tearing Heaven" grasp. "It's you?"

Nine Profound Venerable immediately recognized that the young man attacking him was also Lin Yuan, both sharing the same karmic source. "So the one fighting me isn't your true self?"

Nine Profound Venerable couldn't believe it.

He could sense that the young man standing beside Cang Yulong—whether in physical physique or spiritual pressure— completely surpassed the Taiji Primordial Spirit that had been dueling him moments ago.

The next moment.

The "Tearing Heaven" grasp descended.

Riiiiip.

The absolute "Tearing Heaven" power effortlessly tore through the spacetime barrier surrounding Nine Profound Venerable, then his skin, flesh, bones, and the universe within.

Everything of Nine Profound Venerable—his physical body, soul, and even his mental will— was shredded and torn apart under this ultimate grasp, without the slightest ability to resist, unable to even delay the inevitable destruction for a moment.

Crash.

The instant his physical form and soul were torn apart, boundless vitality surged within Nine Profound Venerable, initiating rapid regeneration.

But with each fragment restored, it was again torn apart by the lingering "Tearing Heaven" power, in a cycle repeating endlessly. In Nine Profound Venerable's despair and unwillingness, his physical body, soul, and inner universe were ultimately torn to complete annihilation.

Not far away.

The Taiji Primordial Spirit stood, silently watching this scene. "Unleashing the full force of the 'Tearing Heaven' grasp indeed surpasses detonating the 'World' divine skill,"

Lin Yuan thought silently to himself.

The divine skill 'World' and the divine skill 'Tearing Heaven' both belong to offensive divine abilities, but 'Tearing Heaven' is far more pure in essence.

The divine skill 'World' has suppression effects and the like, while 'Tearing Heaven' does not.

Moreover, when the divine skill 'World' is detonated, the destructive force is dispersed across tens of millions of light years.

In terms of sheer power, it cannot compare to 'Tearing Heaven.'

The entirety of 'Tearing Heaven's' power is concentrated in that single grasp.

Buzzzzz.

After Nine Profound Venerable's body, soul, and inner universe were torn asunder, nine indistinct auras began gathering nearby, coalescing into the figure of Nine Profound Venerable once again.

However, compared to his prior manifestation, both his aura and oppressive presence had dramatically declined.

This decline was not the kind of temporary reduction that Lin Yuan experienced after detonating the 'World' divine skill, but one requiring an extended period to recover. "Not dead?"

Lin Yuan raised an eyebrow, though he wasn't particularly surprised.

The life-preserving techniques of Chaos Venerables are notoriously formidable. Lin Yuan was, after all, only in the Path Splitting Realm; even when activating the divine skill 'Tearing Heaven,' he could at most severely injure a Venerable.

As for killing one? It would be unlikely—even if it was Nine Profound Venerable, a newly ascended Chaos Realm being.

If Lin Yuan could step into the Chaos Realm, at the same level, using 'Tearing Heaven,' not to mention Nine Profound Venerable—even those peak Chaos Venerables would meet an assured death.

In fact, even without reaching the Chaos Realm, if Lin Yuan could step into the Dominion Realm, elevating the essence of his life, with numerous techniques inherited and cultivated to completion, a single 'Tearing Heaven' grasp would leave Nine Profound Venerable inevitably dead, at least this current physical form would perish beyond recovery. "Then let's do it again."

Lin Yuan's Taiji Primordial Spirit stepped forward.

After a moment of rest, he had practically regained his vigor, fully recovering from the expenditure after detonating 'World,' his combat strength now returned to its peak. "You?"

Nine Profound Venerable's aura weakened, his face pale, and he immediately said, "No need to continue sparring—I concede."

At this point, Nine Profound Venerable was already severely injured. To keep fighting would no longer be a spar—it would be a life-and-death struggle, one where he would have to exhaust every hidden trump card and technique.

A life-and-death struggle?

For the inheritance space of a Great Saint-level domain, engaging in lethal combat with a peer-level Venerable was something Nine Profound Venerable needed to carefully weigh—especially given the current situation.

Even if he were willing to stake his life, the odds were heavily against him.

Just Lin Yuan's Taiji Primordial Spirit alone had forced him to near-full exertion—adding the threat of Lin Yuan's true form, standing by, ready to strike at any moment...

Nine Profound Venerable deemed his chances of victory to be exceedingly slim.

Even if he were to lose in a life-or-death battle, Nine Profound Venerable would not face complete extinction, as he had prepared many life-preserving contingencies in hidden locations, ensuring he could 'revive' if his true form perished.

However, all the investments made in this physical form—its weapons, artifacts, treasured items, and more—would be irretrievably lost.

Lin Yuan certainly wouldn't return any of these valuables to him. "Concede?"

Lin Yuan immediately stopped his assault; he had no desire to push a Chaos Venerable to their brink—one could never predict the extent of their unutilized techniques.

Most critically, within the Myriad Manifestations Void Domain, other Chaos Venerables were still present, many of whom were keenly observing their battle.
